import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from scipy.spatial.distance import pdist, squareform
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import linkage, leaves_list, dendrogram
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
x=pd.read_csv('disease.samples.q1.tsv', sep='\\t', index_col=0)
print(x.shape)
print('columns', list(x.columns))
print('nonzero per sample')
print((x>0).sum().to_string())
print('sum TPM', x.sum().to_string())
print('median', x.median().to_string())
print('mean', x.mean().to_string())
log=np.log1p(x)
print('\\nPearson log corr')
print(log.corr().round(3).to_string())
print('\\nSpearman corr')
print(x.corr(method='spearman').round(3).to_string())
# PCA centered log expression, genes rows samples cols
p=PCA().fit(log.T)
print('\\nPCA var', p.explained_variance_ratio_[:8])
print(pd.DataFrame(p.transform(log.T)[:,:5],index=x.columns,columns=['PC1','PC2','PC3','PC4','PC5']).round(2).to_string())
# hierarchical euclidean standardized? sample distances log raw; corr distance
for name, data in [('log',log),('z', (log-log.mean(axis=1).values[:,None])/log.std(axis=1).replace(0,np.nan).values[:,None])]:
    d=pdist(data.T,metric='euclidean')
    print('\\n',name,'euclidean dist')
    print(pd.DataFrame(squareform(d), index=x.columns, columns=x.columns).round(1).to_string())
    z=linkage(d,method='average')
    print('leaves',x.columns[leaves_list(z)].tolist())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind, mannwhitneyu
x=pd.read_csv('disease.samples.q1.tsv',sep='\\t',index_col=0)
a=['Sample_1','Sample_4','Sample_6','Sample_8','Sample_9']
b=['Sample_2','Sample_3','Sample_5','Sample_7']
# log1p statistics; filter genes with enough expression and fold changes
la=np.log1p(x[a]); lb=np.log1p(x[b])
res=pd.DataFrame(index=x.index)
res['meanA']=la.mean(axis=1); res['meanB']=lb.mean(axis=1)
res['diff']=res.meanA-res.meanB
res['medA']=la.median(axis=1);res['medB']=lb.median(axis=1)
res['fracA']= (x[a]>0).mean(axis=1);res['fracB']=(x[b]>0).mean(axis=1)
res['p']= [ttest_ind(la.loc[g,a],lb.loc[g,b],equal_var=False).pvalue for g in x.index]
res['q']=res.p.rank(method='first')/len(res)
print('TOP A by diff (require mean TPM > 1 in either)')
print(res.loc[(np.expm1(res.meanA)>1)|(np.expm1(res.meanB)>1)].sort_values('diff',ascending=False).head(80)[['meanA','meanB','diff','medA','medB','fracA','fracB']].to_string())
print('\\nTOP B by diff')
print(res.loc[(np.expm1(res.meanA)>1)|(np.expm1(res.meanB)>1)].sort_values('diff').head(80)[['meanA','meanB','diff','medA','medB','fracA','fracB']].to_string())
print('\\nTop t p')
print(res.sort_values('p').head(50)[['meanA','meanB','diff','p']].to_string())
PY"

print(np.log1p(x.loc[present]).median(axis=0).round(2).sort_values(ascending=False).to_string())
# genes with high A relative B and sample consistency: minimum A vs max B perhaps
la=np.log1p(x)
for s in x.columns:
    pass
print('\\nA signature score by sample (mean z among top A markers)')
# manually select induced genes with A-B > 2 and mean A > 2
